title: Database
description: Current Postgres statistics for news_digest, independent of the time picker. Counters are cumulative since statistics reset; estimates are not exact row counts. No query text or session details. Top query timing awaits pg_stat_statements (O7).

panels.title: Database activity since statistics reset
panels.description: Database-wide cumulative counters; cache ratio covers shared buffer hits only, not operating-system cache. Null ratio means no blocks observed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT numbackends AS "Connections", xact_commit AS "Commits", xact_rollback AS "Rollbacks", deadlocks AS "Deadlocks", temp_bytes AS "Temporary bytes", round(100.0*blks_hit/nullif(blks_hit+blks_read,0),2) AS "Buffer hit %", stats_reset AS "Statistics reset (UTC)" FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()

panels.title: Current database and relation sizes
panels.description: Allocated main, index and TOAST storage; excludes WAL and other databases.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pg_database_size(current_database()) AS "Database bytes", coalesce(sum(pg_table_size(relid)),0) AS "Tables and TOAST bytes", coalesce(sum(pg_indexes_size(relid)),0) AS "Index bytes" FROM pg_stat_user_tables

panels.title: Largest relations and row estimates
panels.description: Twenty largest user tables, including indexes and TOAST. Live/dead rows are statistics estimates. Scan counters reset with statistics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT relname AS "Table", pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS "Total bytes", pg_indexes_size(relid) AS "Index bytes", n_live_tup AS "Estimated live rows", n_dead_tup AS "Estimated dead rows", seq_scan AS "Sequential scans", idx_scan AS "Index scans" FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC,relname LIMIT 20

panels.title: Vacuum and analyze snapshots
panels.description: Twenty tables with the largest estimated dead-row counts. Null timestamps mean no retained observation; they do not prove maintenance never ran.

targets.rawSql: SELECT relname AS "Table", n_dead_tup AS "Estimated dead rows", last_vacuum AS "Manual vacuum (UTC)", last_autovacuum AS "Autovacuum (UTC)", last_analyze AS "Manual analyze (UTC)", last_autoanalyze AS "Autoanalyze (UTC)" FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC,relname LIMIT 20

panels.title: Current locks by type and mode
panels.description: Aggregated granted and waiting locks for this database. No SQL, process IDs, users or session details. Empty result means no observed matching locks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT locktype AS "Type", mode AS "Mode", count(*) FILTER (WHERE granted) AS "Granted", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT granted) AS "Waiting" FROM pg_locks WHERE database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) GROUP BY locktype,mode ORDER BY locktype,mode
